title: provisioning.failed v1 payload
$comment: Payload for the `data` member of envelope-v1. Fields are the minimum semantic set from karyalay-mail repository-spec-v1.0 Appendix D; exact types are defined here because Appendix D delegates them to the generated schema. Additive optional fields may be introduced within version 1 where old consumers safely ignore them (Master §22.6); consumers ignore unknown additive fields (Repo 1 Appendix D.1), so this schema does not close the object.

organisation_id.$comment: Type source: Master §6.3 canonical tenant identifier; Master §6.2 UUID.

resource_type.$comment: Type source: Repo 1 Appendix A.31 provisioning_operations.resource_type VARCHAR(32) enumeration.

resource_id.$comment: Type source: Repo 1 Appendix A.31 provisioning_operations.resource_id BINARY(16).

operation_id.$comment: Type source: Repo 1 Appendix A.31 provisioning_operations.id BINARY(16).

error_code.description: Stable error identifier from errors/error-catalog-v1.yaml. The catalog, not this schema, is the closed set.
error_code.$comment: Type source: Repo 1 Appendix E; Appendix A.31 last_error_code VARCHAR(64).

retryable.description: Whether the provisioning failure is safe to retry without operator action.
retryable.$comment: Type source: Repo 1 §39 retry classes; Appendix A.31 state RETRYABLE_FAILURE vs FAILED_ACTION_REQUIRED.
